panel.label: REPORT
panel.name: report_panel

line_editor.name: summary
line_editor.label: One line, e.g. "Water turns black after a teleport"

panel.text: What happened, and what did you expect?

line_editor.name: avatar
line_editor.tool_tip: Sent as typed so we can follow up in world. Leave it empty to stay anonymous.

panel.text: Reports are public on the issue tracker. Don't include anything private.
Sent with the report (from Help > About and your graphics settings)

check_box.label: Attach a log excerpt ([LINES] lines from the viewer log, personal information removed)
check_box.name: attach_log
check_box.tool_tip: The end of this viewer's log (Slipstream.log, or Slipstream-2.log and so on for further viewers). Personal information is removed: names, chat and IM text, IP addresses, e-mail addresses, tokens, account and session handles, and the secret parts of web addresses. Hardware, graphics and audio details are kept. See the WHAT WILL BE SENT tab.

check_box.label: Performance problem (low FPS, stutter): attach a performance capture
check_box.name: attach_perf
check_box.tool_tip: Frame timings measured over a few seconds: frame rate, main thread and graphics card time, the costliest GPU passes and main-thread sections, memory state and graphics settings. No names, places or positions. The same text as World > Improve graphics speed > Frame timings > Capture.

button.label: Take capture
button.name: perf_capture_btn
button.tool_tip: Measure for the number of seconds set in the Frame timings page (10 by default). Keep the view where the problem happens.

panel.text: For low frame rates or stutter: take a capture where it happens.

check_box.label: Attach a screenshot
check_box.name: attach_screenshot
check_box.tool_tip: Taken by the viewer itself; you can't attach other images.

check_box.label: Include the interface
check_box.name: screenshot_ui
check_box.tool_tip: Off: the world only. On: everything on screen except this window, which may include chat or names.

panel.label: MY REPORTS
panel.name: followup_panel
panel.text: Reports you filed from this viewer. Pick one to add more information to it instead of filing a new report, or to see whether we replied. Status is checked every few hours through the report service; you get a notification when something changes. Turn that off with the ReportTrackEnabled setting.

button.label: Forget
button.name: followup_forget_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove this report from the list. You can no longer follow up on it from this viewer.

panel.text: The log excerpt and screenshot options on the REPORT tab apply here too. The comment is public on the issue tracker.

panel.label: WHAT WILL BE SENT
panel.name: payload_panel
panel.text: This is everything the report sends, as it will be sent. It becomes a public issue on the Slipstream issue tracker.
